research.notes: Organization appears inactive or wound down: ProPublica shows revenue collapsing in FY2021 and the EIN is not on the IRS's most recent exempt-organization list. profile.summary: Super Stars Literacy is a nonprofit that provides early reading help to kindergarten through 2nd grade students in Oakland elementary schools. Its programs include daily after-school literacy instruction led by AmeriCorps members, reading support during the school day, and family reading events.

sources.title: Super Stars Literacy Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: ProPublica confirms Super Stars Literacy Inc, EIN 51-0666163, Oakland CA, 501(c)(3); the CommitChange page supports the K-2, AmeriCorps and family-event summary, and OUSD's items are from 2020 when the org was still active. The organization appears wound down after FY2021, which the candidate flagged in its notes.
